SDGs

Aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals

Our work directly contributes to several SDGs, supporting Nepal's commitment to clean energy, sustainable infrastructure, and climate resilience.

7

Affordable & Clean Energy

Our core mandate — delivering clean, affordable energy to Nepali households and industry through solar, micro-hydro, and hybrid systems.

9

Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure

We design and build durable infrastructure — roads, bridges, water systems — adapted for Karnali's challenging terrain.

11

Sustainable Cities & Communities

By bringing reliable energy and infrastructure to remote areas, we contribute to building sustainable, resilient communities.

13

Climate Action

Every megawatt of renewable energy installed is a direct contribution to Nepal's SDG 7 and 13 commitments.

8

Decent Work & Economic Growth

We employ, train, and develop local technicians and engineers, building skill and capacity within Karnali Province.

Community

The Communities We Serve

Behind every project is a story — a village that received electricity for the first time, a school where students can now study after dark, a community whose livelihood was secured.

Jajarkot

Rebuilding in Remote Villages

Post-earthquake reconstruction in Jajarkot district — we handled structural restoration and renewable energy systems installation for 35 community buildings.

Surkhet, Dailekh, Salyan

School Solarisation Programme

Solar rooftop systems installed at over 20 community schools across Karnali Province — providing reliable lighting and learning environments for students.

Kalikot, Mugu

Agricultural Solar Pumping

Ten solar water pumping systems in remote hill communities — reducing walking distances and expanding irrigation access.

Report

Sustainability Report

Our annual Sustainability Report provides comprehensive documentation of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) metrics, project-level impact data, and our roadmap for the year ahead.
